claims.text: Texas Tech's Edward E. Whitacre Jr. College of Engineering received another award from the Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund worth over $19 million.
claims.quote: received an additional Texas Semiconductor Innovation Fund (TSIF) award of over $19
claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster

claims.text: Texas Tech announced the award on November 13th, 2026.
claims.quote: Texas Tech Receives $19 Million Grant to Further Semiconductor Innovation November 13, 2026
claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster

claims.text: The money will help Texas Tech set up a next-generation computing cluster in Lubbock.
claims.quote: The funding of this award will help Texas Tech establish a next-generation computing cluster in Lubbock.
claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster

claims.text: The cluster is not built yet. The announcement says the award will help establish it and gives no install or completion date.
claims.quote: will help Texas Tech establish a next-generation computing
claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster

claims.text: The university describes a computing cluster as linked high-performance servers that work as one system on large parallel workloads.
claims.quote: designed to function as a single unified system to handle massive, parallel workloads.
claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster

claims.text: The project will combine artificial intelligence with high-fidelity simulation data and lab results.
claims.quote: This project will integrate artificial intelligence (AI) with high-fidelity simulation data and experimental results.
claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster

claims.text: The goal is faster development of new semiconductor devices and materials.
claims.quote: This should shorten development cycles for next-generation semiconductor devices and materials.
claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster

claims.text: The engineering dean says Texas Tech will be among the first universities with access to the newest generation of Nvidia chips to power the cluster.

claims.document: Texas Tech Now, the announcement of the fund's November award for the Lubbock computing cluster
